description: Get involved with Justin Fleming's State Representative Campaign. Knock on doors, put up yard signs, collect signatures, or work at a polling place. Justin has been a public servant since 2004 - working with the people of his community to make Susquehanna Township a better place. Justin Fleming would make an excellent PA State Representative, but he needs your help! Sign up to help with his campaign so that the community can know more about all the good work his is doing.
paid_for_by: Paid for by Friends of Justin Fleming
title: Help Elect Justin Fleming for PA's 105th District as State Representative
